fieldNotes.truckGate: The truck yard (dock aprons + drop/fleet parking on the north and east of the buildings) is enclosed by a chain-link perimeter fence, visible in 2022 Street View along the north property line and in tight satellite. The truck yard is entered through a controlled gate off the north-side service drive. The separate front office entrance on Ryan Rd is an open visitor driveway.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible at the truck gate in any imagery (2018/2019/2022/2025 Street View, current satellite). Classified guardShack false / remoteGs true (fenced gated yard with no booth implies kiosk / intercom check-in). Both flagged uncertain — this is an older urban Reinhart-era DC and a small booth could be obscured by trees.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Two connected buildings with dock faces along the north building face and the east side; ~25-50 doors with trailers backed in across multiple faces. Band 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Moderate trailer drop area in the NW of the yard (rows of parked drop trailers) plus a tractor/fleet parking strip. Band 10-25 for true drop (no-tractor) trailers; full fleet count higher.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Tight urban site — the gate-to-dock approach is short (1-2 trucks of stacking room); no deep internal queue lane.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Constrained urban parcel hemmed by Ryan Rd, a strip mall to the north, and residential housing on the east and south. A truck queue at the gate has little stacking room and would quickly spill onto the local street.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense suburban Detroit (Warren MI) — single-family residential housing directly abuts the property on the east and south, strip retail to the north. Clearly Urban.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Two physically connected building sections counted as one facility (one campus); multipleFacilities false.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale visible in overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
